searchText: An observation... if we want to deprecate the envelope, we need to migrate more than just the execution payload header. execution requests, blob kzg commitments, and the state root come to mind, as I believe these are consensus-critical. I'm not sure if this leaks any information about the block that the builder would want obscured if they decide to withhold their block. The kzg commitments are already moved into the bid with ePBS. The execution requests can move there too, same for the state root (which we should delay (eip-7862)). sounds reasonable to me
